problems.problem: Prove that for a continuously differentiable function $f$ satisfying $f(a)=f(b)=0$, one has $\displaystyle\max_{x\in[a,b]}|f'(x)|\ge\frac{1}{(b-a)^2}\int_a^b|f(x)|\,dx$.

problems.problem: Let $\mathbb{Z}_k$ be the additive group of residue classes modulo $k$. Decide whether $\mathbb{Z}_6$ is isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_3$.

Prove that every nonzero rational number $\frac pq$ can be written as $\frac pq=b_1+\frac{b_2}{2!}+\cdots+\frac{b_n}{n!}$, where $n$ is a sufficiently large positive integer and $b_k\in\mathbb Z$ ($k>1$), $0\le b_k<k$, $b_n\ne0$.
